propositions: Add a new blocking DET check p10_verification_presence that passes a leaf plan only if it has a Testing/Verification section or an AC item with an inline code span or verification-vocabulary match.
Add a new blocking DET check p11_ac_vagueness scanning AC item lines with a fixed lexicon using both word boundaries.
The prior vague lexicon matched word prefixes without trailing boundaries, causing 'clean' to fire on 'cleanly' and 'lint clean'; 'clean' is dropped from the blocking lexicon.
Lexicon hits inside recorded code-span positions never fire, and 'etc.' within 30 characters after a code span is exempt as a concrete enumeration.
P6 remains advisory while its lexicon matching is aligned to the same fixed boundary behavior, and its existing posture assertions still hold.
The deterministic-floor prose section of docs/plan-review-gate.md is extended to document P10 and P11.
